lead: Bright cinematic sci-fi film still, friendly construction site in space, safety yellow and red machines.
notes: Mood-only mini images for astro_industry.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen astro_industry-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish astro_industry-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.
